text:
jamie: Heads-up — I'm starting a one-page refresh for the 'Starter: local deploy + auth flow' quickstart. Goal: time-to-first-response < 5m, simplify the auth section into a toggleable 'dev token' example, and add a short KMS/rotation note. Planning a PR by Fri EOD, need reviewers from devex + eng-runtime. cc @noor @kevin

noor: Love the idea. Can you add a tiny troubleshooting note for 'permission denied: docker.sock'? A new contributor hit that in yesterday's workshop and it blocked them for 10m.

kevin: Also please add a minimal streaming example in the starter app — a lot of folks expect streaming in the quickstart now. Keeps the demo more realistic.

jamie: Good call. Draft inline snippet I'll include in the PR: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDWOOD_DEV_TOKEN")
resp = client.generate("hi")
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk)
```
I'll put a short note that in prod you should use a config file + KMS rather than an env token.

sophia: If you're changing the auth layout, I can update the quickstart hero image under /assets/ (swap env vars to the new layout). I can do the PNG update in the same PR.

noor: I'll do a smoke run on mac + linux when the PR is up. Ping me for approval after the preview site builds.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint succeeded. preview-build available at https://deploy-preview-789.docs.redwood.ai (auto-deployed)

jamie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 — description & test plan included. Requesting reviews from @noor @kevin @sophia. Diff touches quickstart.md, assets/quickstart-hero.png, and examples/starter/streaming.py.

kevin: Left a small nit: rename "dev token" -> "temporary dev token" and add a one-liner about rotation/TTL (and don't suggest committing it). Otherwise looks solid.

noor: LGTM aside from kevin's nit. I'll run checks and approve once preview build passes.

jamie: :thumbsup: I'll update wording and push a tiny follow-up commit. Plan to merge tomorrow AM if all green. Thanks everyone!
